neural_planner_fixed_head.strengths: Generalizes to Hindi/Hinglish phrasing and extracts 2-step dependencies
neural_planner_fixed_head.weaknesses: Cannot generate 3-hop plans due to fixed 2-subtask prediction horizon; fails on unknown tool rejection

deterministic_validator.mechanism: Validates DAG acyclicity and legal tool usage without replacing gold plans

deterministic_executor.role: AST tool evaluation and string manipulations

attribution_integrity: The 80% hybrid score is attributable to the combination of neural dependency identification and deterministic graph validation. Raw neural subtask coverage remains 48%, necessitating variable-length autoregressive generation.
